final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.mix AS mix, s1.cnt AS cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3) SELECT s3.mix, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
